english.toefl: Full: 5.0 new scale or 103 old; limited: 4.0 new or 79 old
english.note: IELTS 6.5 / Duolingo 115 can meet limited-status minimum. New-scale scores after January 20, 2026; old before January 21. TOEFL Essentials/MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted. Exemptions include degree, two years study, or two years work in U.S./approved country within five years.

applicationFee.note: Domestic and international $90 under current central policy. Domestic waivers for eligible categories; international waiver only under approved valid exchange agreement. Program pages generally exclude international waivers. Central exchange-agreement exception means waiver availability is not exclusively domestic; international applicants should confirm approved agreement with Graduate College.

documents: Personal statement: past, current and future research interests
International English test results if required
requirements.note: Previous neuroscience/related research required; one year or more highly desirable. GPA normally at least 3.0 in last 60 undergraduate hours; master's/postbaccalaureate experience can compensate. Contact faculty before applying; normally specific mentor admission with rare rotation exceptions.

funding.note: All domestic and international students receive annual stipend, tuition and health insurance while in good standing. Current undated stipend at least $31,500; confirm rate. At least one term support from teaching.
